name: Lecture notes
pitch: Turn a lecture transcript into structured study notes with key concepts highlighted.
instructions: Read the transcript file with file_read. Identify the main topic and section headings. List key concepts as bullet points, bolding the first mention of each. Write a short summary of each section in your own words. Create a new notes file with make_page, pasting the structured notes into it. If the transcript is empty or cannot be read, say so and stop. Do not invent facts or concepts that are not in the text.
starters: convert this lecture transcript into structured study notes
turn this transcript into study notes

examples.ask: convert this lecture transcript into structured study notes
examples.does: read the transcript, list key concepts with bolding, and create a notes page

readme:
# Lecture notes
Turn a lecture transcript into structured study notes with key concepts highlighted.

- Reads transcript files
- Writes a new notes page
- Highlights key concepts in bold
- Does not invent facts or concepts

Needs: file_read, file_write, make_page

Will not create notes if the transcript is empty or missing.
